attacks.name: Burn Baby Burn
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Immolate|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Nova Burst
steps: When this attack is chosen, during the Pay |!power| Cost step of the attack, this character may spend up to 7 additional |!power|. Add 1 die to each attack made for each |!power| spent in this way.
After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the Incinerate special condition.
If this attack deals |!damage|, after each attack is resolved, this character suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Too Hot to Handle
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character. The chosen character drops 1 Asset token it is holding.

superPowers.name: Like Touching a Stovetop
superPowers.body: When an enemy character Pushes or Throws this character, after the effect is resolved, this character may use this superpower. The character that caused this effect suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Controlled Burn
superPowers.body: When this character ends an Advance, it gains 1 |!power| for each character within |!range| 2 of it that has the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.
